chunks: And al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, said:
"All water is pure except that which you know to be impure."

key_terms.إِلَّا: except; introducing the exclusion from the general rule
key_terms.طَاهِرٌ: pure; ritually clean and not najis
key_terms.عَلِمْتَ: you know; certainty or established knowledge
key_terms.قَذِرٌ: impure; filthy or ritually impure in context
key_terms.مَاءٍ: water; the subject of the ruling on purity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the purity of water in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the legal principle that water is presumed pure by default. Only water known with certainty to be impure is treated as impure in ritual law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"All water is pure except for that which you know to be impure."
